tool_descriptions.file_manager: Read, write, search, and organize files within allowed directories
tool_descriptions.memory_manager: Store and retrieve contextual information and user preferences
tool_descriptions.search_tool: Search for files on the local system using Everything Search
tool_descriptions.system_info: Query system information like disk space, processes, and network status
tool_descriptions.vision_tool: Analyze screenshots, extract text with OCR, describe images
tool_descriptions.email_manager: Send, draft, and list emails via Microsoft Outlook (requires confirmation to send)
tool_descriptions.voice_tool: Transcribe audio to text using Whisper
tool_descriptions.planning_agent: Break down complex tasks into sequential steps
tool_descriptions.api_tool: Make HTTP requests to approved APIs
tool_descriptions.clipboard: Read from or write to the Windows clipboard
tool_descriptions.calendar: List, query, and add calendar events via Microsoft Outlook
tool_descriptions.web_search: Search the web using DuckDuckGo and return summarised results
tool_descriptions.browser_automation: Open URLs or control the system browser via PowerShell
tool_descriptions.show_notification: Show a Windows desktop toast notification with a title and message
tool_descriptions.run_code: Execute sandboxed Python or PowerShell snippets (10s timeout, network blocked)
tool_descriptions.set_reminder: Set a time-based reminder that fires a desktop notification
tool_descriptions.cancel_reminder: Cancel a pending reminder by ID
tool_descriptions.list_processes: List running processes filtered and sorted by name, CPU, or memory
tool_descriptions.get_process_info: Get detailed info about a specific process by name or PID
tool_descriptions.kill_process: Terminate a process by name or PID (requires confirmation)
tool_descriptions.search_contacts: Search Outlook and local contacts by name, email, or company
tool_descriptions.add_contact: Add a contact to the local contacts store
tool_descriptions.get_news: Fetch latest headlines from an RSS news feed
tool_descriptions.list_news_feeds: List all built-in news feed sources
tool_descriptions.git_status: Show git working tree status (staged, unstaged, untracked)
tool_descriptions.git_log: Show recent commit history for a git repository
tool_descriptions.git_diff: Show diff between working tree and HEAD or between refs
tool_descriptions.git_branches: List local and remote branches in a repository
tool_descriptions.git_commit: Stage all changes and create a git commit (requires confirmation)
tool_descriptions.diff_text: Compare two text strings line-by-line and show differences
tool_descriptions.diff_files: Compare two files and return a unified diff
tool_descriptions.image_generate: Generate an image from a text prompt via local SD or cloud providers
tool_descriptions.remember: Store a fact or preference in long-term semantic memory (Qdrant/JSON)
tool_descriptions.recall: Search long-term memory by semantic similarity or keyword
tool_descriptions.forget: Delete a specific memory entry by ID (requires confirmation)
tool_descriptions.list_memories: List all stored memories, optionally filtered by category
tool_descriptions.save_conversation: Append a message turn to the persistent conversation history log
tool_descriptions.get_conversation_history: Retrieve recent conversation turns from the history log
tool_descriptions.clear_conversation_history: Erase all or a specific session's conversation history (requires confirmation)
